en: Now, one important note about agent skills.
You can rely on them being activated
automatically, which is kind of the default,
the idea behind agent skills. But if you
know that a certain skill should be
activated, if you don't wanna hope that it
gets activated, you can trigger it
explicitly in Pi with a slash command, with
/skill:,
and then you can target any skill you have
by its name. So tanstack start, create plan,
you can use this, execute this like a
command, and that will activate that skill.
So that's a nice way of explicitly
activating a skill if you know it should be
activated and you don't want to hope that it
gets activated.
Again, not necessarily the default, but
something you can do and something that's
worth knowing, that there is a slash command
starting with skill colon for every single
skill you added.
